description: This file defines a React component named GameScreen that manages a simple game involving spawning and moving targets within a specified time limit. It handles animation, target spawning, user interactions, and game state management.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the game state, including score, elapsed time, targets, and running status.

methods.name: spawnTarget
methods.description: Creates a new target with randomized position, velocity, and size within the play area.

methods.name: removeTarget
methods.description: Removes a target by its ID and optionally increments the score.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Main animation loop that updates target positions, spawns new targets, and checks for game end condition.
